text:
Jakob Chychrun spent the week in headlines for a hit, not a goal. Nick Cousins returned to Ottawa's lineup after a Chychrun hit that, per RMNB's headline, left him saying "I've never been hit that hard before", and Cousins said he had no hard feelings. On the ice, Chychrun has 16 points in 22 games, and Tom Gulitti of NHL.com reported he took a maintenance day Wednesday after missing the last seven minutes of a first period.

His own shooting is the soft spot: 3 goals on 67 shots, 4.5% against a range of 6.5 to 10% we'd expect, after scoring plenty last season. Washington has also scored 5.1 fewer goals than its chances deserved with him on the ice. Both of those tend to swing back.

Evolving-Hockey had him 23rd among defensemen last season and noted he was better than his goals then, too. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking shows a defenseman who gets into the slot (92nd percentile). For a Capitals team that has lost seven of ten, his finishing turning would help.
